Best trolling motor battery setup (2026)

For most fishing boats, the best setup is a 24V or 36V LiFePO4 lithium battery system, depending on your trolling motor's voltage and power requirements.

Lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) batteries are generally preferable to traditional lead-acid batteries because they're lighter, offer more usable capacity, maintain voltage better under load, and typically last through more charge cycles.

Essential installation components

Circuit breaker: Use the motor manufacturer's specified rating. Minn Kota commonly specifies 50A or 60A, depending on the model.

Marine-grade wiring: Size it according to current draw and cable length.

Lithium-compatible charger: Match the battery voltage and charging specifications.

Battery management system (BMS): Confirm its continuous and peak discharge limits can handle the motor, and that it supports the intended series configuration if applicable.

Separate starting battery: Keep the outboard's starting circuit separate from the trolling motor battery system.

Minn Kota's official wiring and battery guide provides model-specific protection and cable sizing.
